*F-NIZK* (Non-interactive zero knowledge) is part of *Layer 4: Commitments and Proofs* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Groth, Ostrovsky, and Sahai. [*New techniques for noninteractive zero-knowledge*](http://www0.cs.ucl.ac.uk/staff/J.Groth/NIZKJournal.pdf). Journal of the ACM, 59(3):11:1–11:35, 2012.
- Rackoff and Simon. [*Non-interactive zero-knowledge proof of knowledge and chosen ciphertext attack*](https://doi.org/10.1007/3-540-46766-1_35). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 1991, 1991.
